definition.instructions: Check: what service is discussed; which listed sector covers it; whether only a payment method is being mentioned; whether the service is identifiable. Classify the claimed service. An identifiable unlisted sector is other, while insufficient evidence is unclear.

criteria.technology_telecom: Software, devices, online accounts, internet or phones.
criteria.healthcare: Medical care, pharmacy or health insurance.
criteria.employment: Jobs, recruiting, payroll or workplace services.
criteria.unclear: Insufficient evidence to identify a sector.
